method: Built-in image_gen; realistic industrial-design refinement of previous catalog image, using simplified GLB only as a loose concept
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a highly convincing commercial studio PHOTOGRAPH of a real manufacturable compact home treadmill for an ecommerce catalog.
The input image is ONLY a loose concept for equipment category, approximate size, graphite and restrained orange color scheme, viewpoint and warm studio style. It copies a simplified GLB too literally. Replace its crude rectangular block construction and toy-like console with realistic refined industrial design. This is a deliberate realism redesign, not merely a texture upgrade.
One compact electric home treadmill in unfolded flat running position, approximately 78 cm wide, 162 cm long and 138 cm high. Slender yet sturdy graphite powder-coated steel chassis and two subtly curved or raked uprights, with credible concealed wiring, bolts and secure molded joints. A believable long continuous finely textured black running belt wrapping around front and rear rollers. Flat anti-slip foot platforms on both sides with fine longitudinal traction ribs and thin burnt-orange accents; NOT ladder rungs or deeply segmented block steps. Rounded rear roller end caps with recessed adjustment holes. Low smoothly sculpted charcoal injection-molded front motor hood with restrained ventilation slots and realistic panel seams, modest cushioning feet and transport wheels. Two ergonomic gently curved handrails with rubber grips and small metallic pulse sensors.
A practical slightly tilted molded consumer treadmill console with rounded contours, a modest inset dark smoked LCD screen, small tactile speed and incline buttons, an orange magnetic safety key with a short black tether, a shallow phone shelf, and subtle integrated bottle recesses. Display powered off with natural glass reflections. No huge teal slab, no oversized touchscreen, no text overlays or branding. Restrained orange hinge details where the deck meets the uprights. Mechanically coherent proportions and joins.
Actual product photography look, natural surface imperfections at micro scale, finely textured powder coat and molded plastic, rubber belt and soft specular highlights, realistic manufactured edges. Preserve the open belt-entry end nearest camera in lower-left and console farther away in upper-right. Full treadmill entirely visible, comfortably centered square composition, same warm off-white seamless studio floor/background and soft diffuse lighting with gentle contact shadow. No people, other equipment, logos, watermark or dimension labels. Avoid low-poly geometry, beveled blocks, CGI/toy appearance, tread slats, curved running surface or commercial gym bulk.
review: User requested realistic product photography rather than exact reproduction of the simplified GLB. Final image has molded console and motor hood, ergonomic grips with pulse sensors, safety tether, continuous running belt, ribbed side platforms and realistic roller end caps. Category, approximate proportions, graphite/orange palette and warm studio style retained. Product geometry, dimensions and domain rules unchanged. AI-generated product illustration, not a dimensional source or a photograph of a manufactured product.
